description: Header file defining the SensorDirectConnection class within the android::SensorService namespace, which manages direct sensor connections, including configuration, access control, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SensorService::SensorDirectConnection
classes.description: Manages direct sensor connections, handling configuration, access rights, and communication with sensor hardware.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state or information about the connection to a String8 or ProtoOutputStream.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the UID associated with the connection.

methods.name: getOpPackageName
methods.description: Returns the operation package name associated with the connection.

methods.name: getHalChannelHandle
methods.description: Returns the HAL channel handle identifier.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if the provided memory configuration is equivalent to the current connection.

methods.name: onSensorAccessChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in sensor access permissions.

methods.name: onMicSensorAccessChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in microphone sensor access.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the connection.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID.

methods.name: onFirstRef
methods.description: Initializes the connection when first referenced.

methods.name: getSensorChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the sensor channel associated with this connection.

methods.name: enableDisable
methods.description: Enables or disables a sensor handle with specified sampling and batching parameters.

methods.name: setEventRate
methods.description: Sets the event rate for a sensor handle.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data.

methods.name: configureChannel
methods.description: Configures the sensor channel with a specified rate level.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the connection and releases resources.

methods.name: hasSensorAccess
methods.description: Checks if the connection has sensor access rights.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sends configuration to the sensor device.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Stops all active sensor report requests, with optional backup.

methods.name: stopAllLocked
methods.description: Stops all sensor report requests with lock held.

methods.name: recoverAll
methods.description: Recovers previously stopped sensor requests.

methods.name: capRates
methods.description: Caps sensor report rates when mic toggle is on.

methods.name: uncapRates
methods.description: Recovers sensor report rates after capping.

methods.name: isRateCappedBasedOnPermission
methods.description: Checks if rate capping is based on permission, with lazy evaluation.
